ablation.name: local_t23_ll_mean_only
ablation.notes: T23: Plan E Mean-Only LL AdaIN. Training-free concept (endpoint_adain_mode is inference-only, training identical to T11). 仅迁移 LL mean (色调) 不迁移 std (结构), 是最 LPIPS 中性的色调迁移. ll_K + α*(target_mean - pred_mean). 高频子带仍用 WCT. endpoint_adain_scale_ll=0.5 (T11 是 0.0=LL 锁死). 假设: CLIP 正向 (色调迁移), LPIPS 中性 (结构保留), 可能打破 1:8 trade-off. 目标: clip>0.7213 AND lpips<0.2868 (dual beat T11).
